title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
content_snippet: Google will now allow you to remove visible watermarks from the images, videos, and music made with AI tools. With the update, you can toggle off a new "Media watermark" setting in Gemini and Google's AI video generator, Flow. When toggled off, Google will remove the "sparkle" watermark that appears in the bottom-right corner of […]
title_zh: 用户现可关闭谷歌 Gemini 的可见水印
summary_zh: 谷歌允许用户移除其 AI 工具生成的图片、视频和音乐中的可见水印，用户可在 Gemini 和 Flow 中关闭“媒体水印”设置。
key_points: 谷歌让用户可关闭 Gemini 及 Flow 的可见水印
关闭水印设置不影响隐形数字标识符

title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
content_snippet: Turning off this setting won't affect invisible benchmarks used to identify an AI generated file

title: LiquidAI LFM2.5-VL-3B: a 3.1B local VLM that beats Gemma-4 E4B — screen understanding 2.5 → 82.2
content_snippet:
LiquidAI LFM2.5-VL-3B: a 3.1B local VLM that beats Gemma-4 E4B — screen understanding 2.5 → 82.2

TL;DR: LiquidAI released LFM2.5-VL-3B, a 3.1B vision-language model that runs fully local (llama.cpp, MLX, vLLM, even a WebGPU demo).

• Beats Gemma-4 E4B (8B) 69.4 vs 59.7; edges Qwen3.5-4B • Screen understanding: 2.5 → 82.2 on ScreenSpot-v2 Web (huge jump) • 228 tok/s on M5 Max, 20 tok/s on a Galaxy S26 Ultra • Function calling / object grounding inclu
title_zh: LiquidAI 发布 LFM2.5-VL-3B：本地视觉语言模型，屏幕理解能力碾压 Gemma-4
summary_zh: LiquidAI 推出了一个 31 亿参数的视觉语言模型 LFM2.5-VL-3B，可在本地运行，并在屏幕理解基准测试中以 82.2 分大幅超越谷歌 Gemma-4 E4B 模型，支持多种推理框架。
key_points: 该 3.1B 参数模型可在本地运行，支持 llama.cpp、MLX 等多种框架
屏幕理解基准测试得分 82.2，显著优于竞争对手 Gemma-4 E4B

title: Open-source Python library + no-code web dashboard for evaluating oncology AI models at clinical decision thresholds. [P]
content_snippet:
Most classification metrics for oncology AI models (AUC, ICC, MAE) measure global agreement. They don't answer the question that actually matters at the point of care: how reliable is this model at the exact cutoff that decides whether a patient gets flagged, biopsied, or treated?

I built oncothresh to evaluate models at a specific clinical threshold rather than in aggregate: sensitivity/specificity/PPV/NPV at the cutoff, bootstrap confidence
title_zh: 开源 Python 库及无代码仪表板：用于在临床决策阈值评估肿瘤学 AI 模型
summary_zh: 研究人员发布了一个开源 Python 库和无代码仪表板，专门用于在特定临床决策阈值评估肿瘤学 AI 模型的可靠性，解决了传统评估指标无法回答诊疗关键问题这一痛点。
key_points: 该工具库专注于在临床决策阈值点评估肿瘤 AI 模型的可靠性
解决传统指标（如 AUC）无法评估模型在实际诊疗中表现的问题
